bio: I’m an Electrical and Computer Engineering student at The Ohio State University with a passion for programming and electronics. I believe that problem-solving and a curiosity for the unfamiliar is the key to success, a mindset that drives my ultimate goal of designing electronics and PCBs for the aerospace industry. I'm always looking to learn and grow as a person. Whenever I want to take a break, you can usually find me lifting at the gym, exploring new places around the city, or simply unwinding by binging a good show.
